deployments_detail.use: AI-driven customer-support workflows (chatbot triage, auto-classification, response suggestions) being explored/implemented in the Diesel Laptops support-engineering organization under Snap-on. [not disclosed]
"Fast-Track Intelligent Diagnostics" AI-driven scan tools (data from millions of repairs) + TRITON platform

Fast-Track Intelligent Diagnostics: patented AI-guided diagnostic workflow that takes a vehicle fault code and filters the vast body of repair data into a focused, step-by-step path to the fix, shipping in ZEUS, TRITON, APOLLO and related scan tools. [Snap-on (proprietary); repair-intelligence engine built with Predii]

Predii Repair Intelligence powering the ZEUS diagnostic platform: machine learning and NLP applied to billions of crowd-sourced repair orders and warranty records to surface likely fixes for technicians. [Predii]
deployments_detail.value: Technicians using Zeus reported average savings of 30 minutes per job in diagnostic time

deployments_detail.use: SureTrack: expert-information system that data-mines a database of over 2 billion real-world repair records to give technicians Top Repairs, Real Fixes and a Troubleshooter view linking codes, symptoms and commonly replaced components; shipping across SOLUS, APOLLO, MODIS, TRITON, VERUS and ZEUS tools. [Snap-on / Mitchell 1 (proprietary)]

Smart Data: intelligent feature within Fast-Track Intelligent Diagnostics that automatically filters and prioritizes the relevant data parameters (PIDs) for a specific trouble code and auto-flags out-of-range readings, so technicians see only pertinent live data. Shipping on APOLLO, TRITON and ZEUS scanners. [Snap-on (proprietary)]

Preteckt AI predictive maintenance (acquired via Diesel Laptops, now part of Snap-on): real-time remote vehicle monitoring using machine learning to predict component failures on transit/coach buses and trucks before breakdowns. Deployed in production at Pinellas Suncoast Transit Authority. [Preteckt / Diesel Laptops (Snap-on)]
deployments_detail.value: rolled out to more than 50% of the PSTA bus fleet

deployments_detail.use: Preteckt (formerly Preteckt/Watchtower) AI predictive-maintenance capability brought into Snap-on's portfolio through Diesel Laptops' acquisition, integrating AI, machine learning and predictive maintenance for 24/7 fleet vehicle monitoring and proactive repair planning. [Preteckt / Diesel Laptops (Snap-on)]

Mitchell 1 (Snap-on) 'Did You Mean' smart search: intelligent search feature in the 1Search Plus platform that automatically recognizes misspelled or mistyped industry terms and suggests correct spellings, deployed across ProDemand, ShopKey Pro and TruckSeries. [Mitchell 1 (Snap-on)]

Level 5 Automated Tool Control (ATC): tool-storage system that uses high-speed cameras/digital imaging and proprietary software (computer vision) to scan drawers and record in real time which tools are removed and replaced, providing automated asset accountability and FOD prevention for aviation, industrial and military users. [Snap-on (proprietary digital imaging)]
